main_text.p: neatur lege Cornelià de Sica-riis, in quam tantum venit do-lus; non etiam actione injuria-rum, quod animus injuriandi nullus sit; & maleficia distin-guat, voluntas ac propositum delinquentis. Quia l.53.in init.D.de Furt.tamen is potest esse in culpâ levissimâ, adeoque ejus impudentiæ ve-nit imputandum, quod non cautius fuerit jaculatus; & ea venitl.44.D. Ad l. A-quil. in l. Aquiliam, ideo eti-am adversus talem actioni ex l. Aquiliâ competenti locus erit. Ne dicam, eum forte & ideo Aquiliæ nomine teneri, qui in adversarium remotum jecit lapidem, quod id non tam fecerit urgente necessitate, quâ-irâ[?] incitante, adeoque non tam sui defendendi gratiâ, quam quidem animo ulcifcendi. Cum illil.1.45. §.4.[?] tantum censeantur innoxii, qui cum aliter se tueri non possent, damnum alicui intulerunt. Neque 2, obstat fe-

page.notes: The first and second marginal notes are printed in very small type and are partly blurred; "l.53" and "l.1.45" are read as the most likely numerals. The third note's "§.4." sits in a separate line; the abbreviation may read differently. "irâ" in the hyphenated word "quâ-irâ" is uncertain. Long s has been normalised to s throughout. The superscript "2" after "Neque" is copied as printed; it is probably a footnote mark. Catchword "cun-" at the foot right.
